Recorded claim:
Bug 1895923 added a browser_parsable_css.js ignore entry for a new upstream html.css content parse message. It matches the source name, the specific parser error, and isFromDevTools:false. This keeps the static test from suppressing unrelated CSS errors or DevTools messages. D209935 asked to run the test file and accepted the port; no local test was run in this history study. The current checkout has since changed this test path, so use this as a scoped historical test-maintenance pattern.

Provenance: e0bfe36a0be231f8c2ad813487d2d4409a64a9d8b249e9bffddf37ac5809df52. Original evidence IDs: 3e98874c2c3f4920f492629da82da5df9eb8ae99b510728efa526b23f39145c6, a8e2ae706f3e053246b076850b5b33c5776f3d31a966e0e18874348fddf44af6, ef385d8ff7eb1f90f36dbf3755ecd6b9256b6ed11d0981ee6cefa601639b60ca.
